contact.evidence_quote: “One of the unique strengths of being part of Sony Group is the opportunity to draw on world-class talent and creativity from across our entertainment businesses,” said Grace Chen, Vice President, Network Advertising, Loyalty & Licensed Merchandise, Sony Interactive Entertainment. “This new brand spot pairs the breadth of gaming experiences available on PlayStation with LISA’s music and global appeal, creating new opportunities for us to engage audiences beyond traditional gaming communities.”
